name: SubmitStorm
description: Directory submission service for startups, SaaS and AI tools: one brief, a one-time fee, proof of every listing.
included: Dofollow and high-DR directories first, matched to the product's category
Dashboard counting submissions as they land
Final report with a proof screenshot and link per listing (Excel and CSV)
Badge component: up to 50 more directories
Domain Rating recorded at the start and at the end
No directory repeated for the same site
